tooltips.turboSmsAuthToken: Leave blank to preserve the saved token.
tooltips.turboSmsConnectTimeout: Maximum time allowed to establish an HTTPS connection.
tooltips.turboSmsRequestTimeout: Maximum total duration of one API request.
tooltips.turboSmsSendType: Hybrid - if the message was not delivered in Viber, it is automatically sent as SMS
tooltips.turboSmsSyncCron:
Crontab notation. Defines synchronization frequency.

`*/5 * * * *` - every 5 minutes

`0 */2 * * *` - every 2 hours

`30 1 * * *` - at 01:30 once a day
tooltips.turboSmsNotificationUsers: Select active internal users. If no active recipient can be resolved, all active administrators are notified.
tooltips.turboSmsNotificationTeams: All active internal users in the selected teams are notified. Duplicate recipients are removed.

messages.turboSmsSyncStarted: Synchronization is already queued or running.
